content.title: Which grocery stores are open — and closed — on Easter Sunday 2026?
content.text: BusinessSeveral grocery stores, including Walmart and ShopRite, will be open on Easter 2026, which falls on Sunday, April 5.Walmart/BJ's/ShopRite/Aldi/Canva/Katherine RodriguezBy Katherine Rodriguez | NJ.comEaster 2026 falls on April 5 this year.Most grocery stores should be open on Easter 2026 should you need to get last-minute ingredients for your Easter feast.However, there are four grocery stores that will remain closed to give their employees time off to celebrate the holiday.Here is what you need to know about the grocery stores that will remain open, and those that will close on Easter 2026.It is best to check with your local grocery store for the most up-to-date hours, as operating hours can vary by store.Which grocery stores are open on Easter Sunday?The following major supermarket chains in New Jersey are expected to be open on Easter:ACME (6 a.m. - 10 p.m.; varies by store) BJ’s Wholesale Club (8 a.m. - 7 p.m.; varies by store)Foodtown (varies by store)Lidl (8 a.m. - 9 p.m.)ShopRite (varies by store)Stop & Shop (7 a.m. - 5 p.m.)Trader Joe’s (8 a.m. - 9 p.m.)Walmart (6 a.m. - 11 p.m.; varies by store)Wegmans (6 a.m. - 12 a.m.)Whole Foods (7:30 a.m. - 6 p.m.; varies by store)Which four grocery stores are closed on Easter Sunday?The following four major supermarket chains in New Jersey are scheduled to be closed on Easter Sunday:Is Walmart open on Easter?
